basic_info.main_problem: 我对作为Elementary school teacher的新工作感到紧张，并not断担心自己会成为一个糟糕的老师；这些Self-doubt与not足感在接受工作并搬家后出现，随着开工日期临近而加重，导致每日Anxiety与自我批评，并影响睡眠。
basic_info.core_demands: 因为这些负面想法正在影响我的自信并引发对新工作的Significant anxiety，我寻求咨询以识do not并挑战灾难化与负性预测，重建更平衡的认知与自信。
growth_experiences: Once worked as a substitute teacher and received positive feedback (patience and creative teaching activities were affirmed), which provides positive evidence for their teaching ability, but currently tends to regard it as 'possibly a fluke'.
过去一直对自己的能力较为自信，not yet出现类似的Anxiety与Self-doubt。

core_beliefs: 我会成为一个糟糕的老师

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在一开始就表现出色并完全胜任，就说明I am not good enough/是个糟糕的老师

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会搞砸一切，我会成为一个糟糕的老师

special_situations.event: 在准备教案时被负性思维打断
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Student有not理解的情况，就说明我not适合当老师
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试放松与自我安慰，但仍难以专注于规划
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果孩子们都听not懂，那就是我not行

special_situations.event: When recalling positive feedback from past substitute teaching, still believes this time will fail
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果正面证据not能保证这次必然成功，就not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes positive feedback to 'luck', to maintain high vigilance toward risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些好评可能只是偶然，这次会not一样

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能应付not来这些责任，结果会很糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent teacher, to maintain confidence and stability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被证实without能，担心让Student学not到东西并遭到negate
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与提前担忧来预防失败与羞耻
避免向亲友透露Anxiety以减少被评价

object_relations.object_representation: Student可能因为我的not足而学not到东西

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to review and integrate past positive feedback and evidence of ability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将正面证据视为not可靠或侥幸，预测这次会失败（“这次not同”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持“这次not同”的解释，语气谨慎、带怀疑色彩，use条件句与反问来Undoing正面证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论是否向亲友表达Anxiety、寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达担忧会被评判为without能或麻烦他人，因此not愿开口
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻描淡写自身需求，Displacement话题到工作任务；语气收敛、减少情感外露。

target_behavior.behavior: 灾难化的Self-denial性思维（如“我会成为一个糟糕的老师”）
antecedent: 想到即将开始的新工作职责
target_behavior.core_reason: 新环境与岗位的not确定性激发对能力的怀疑；伴随灾难化、预测not yet来与过度概括等认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性、通过提前担忧获得短暂的控制感与心理预防
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified、Decreased confidence、影响备课专注与效率，并进一步扰乱睡眠

target_behavior.behavior: 入睡困难（难以入睡、夜间Anxiety反复）
antecedent: 夜间回想工作职责与可能失败的情境
睡前的自我批评与负性自动思维活跃

target_behavior.function: 以反复思考和担忧试图预先避免失败（负性Reinforcement的控制感）
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality，白天精力与功能受影响

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向亲友表达工作Anxiety与寻求支持

考虑求助被评价的风险
